title: Round 3 of the JA Joomla j6 slot contracts (r3d): JA Coach, JA Colab, JA Candidate and JA Cityguide, not ready in round 1, wear a design system from their 1.0.1 re-release
steps: S1: node --test test/contracts.test.mjs test/tokenize.test.mjs test/slot.test.mjs test/cms.test.mjs (cwd packages/design/tracy-ds-slot).
S2: read templates/joomla-ja-{coach,colab,candidate,cityguide}.json through loadContract; build the Toggl Track module sheet for JA Coach and JA Colab (joomlaSlot).
S3: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/ds-slot.js contractFor(templateKeyOf({platform:'joomla', template:'ja_<name>'}), {key:'quickstart/ja-<name>/j6', version}) for each, at 1.0.1 and at 1.0.0.

S4: node packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/pass-joomla.mjs ja-coach --port 53745 --cdp 9876 --evidence <tmp> (release restored in Docker, stylesheets tokenized, Moxie, MotherDuck, Toggl Track and Apple worn, cleared, stand removed).

selectors.contracts: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-{coach,colab,candidate,cityguide}.json ready, minVersion, templateVars, keepScopes, keepDefaults, keepDefaultsYield, keepGround, keepText, keepColors, followRules, sideRules, selectors.onAccent, selectors.container, t3DevmodeOff

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r3d-2026-10-11/README.md: each template measured on 1.0.0 tokenized in place and on its 1.0.1 build stood up from its own zip; desktop and phone screenshots checked by eye.
